guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例

guides.concept: 以水壓傳力支承對位和機電幾何理解人字門安裝驗證。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Understand miter-gate installation through pressure paths, bearing alignment and actuator geometry. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。

pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：船閘人字門安裝
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Miter-gate installation for navigation locks
guides.concept: 以水壓傳力支承對位和機電幾何理解人字門安裝驗證。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
guides.conceptEn: Understand miter-gate installation through pressure paths, bearing alignment and actuator geometry. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
procedure: 人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。每米寬的垂直平面條帶可以先建立荷載量級，但門葉斜角、水平主梁與接觸不連續會改變實際傳力；不能把條帶合力直接當成啟閉機的推力需求。 假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。
人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。斜角影響斜接位置、接觸及受力，但幾何一致不代表支承壓力已均勻；測量應分開閉合位置與轉動包絡，避免用設計投影尺寸直接安排吊運或調整作業。 假設開口寬20m、各葉與橫向成20°，葉長l=10/cos20°=10.6418m，上游突出10tan20°=3.6397m；忽略接縫細節。
面板將局部水壓傳給加勁材，支承距離與邊界條件決定彎曲而非只看整扇門重量。一米寬簡支條帶忽略雙向板作用和焊接約束，只能建立比較基準；腐蝕減薄、初始變形與接觸細節會改變局部反應，需要與實際板格配置對照。 假設一米寬簡支條帶p=100kPa、跨0.50m、厚0.020m，M=pL²/8=3.125kN·m/m，σ=6M/t²=46.875MPa。
門葉在水中與排水檢修時的有效重量不同，密閉艙浮力與材料體積不能混用。支承分擔還取決於重心、浮心及上部約束，重量差只給垂直合力；若有漏水或排氣狀態改變，浮力邊界會更新，不能沿用安裝初期的固定值。 假設門葉質量200000kg、密閉排水體積50m³、淡水1000kg/m³，淨向下力(m−ρV)g=1471.5kN；未分配各支承。
樞軸將門葉作用傳入底部埋件，名義承壓可以用投影面積估量，但不是實際接觸峰值。軸承曲面、間隙、潤滑和偏心會集中壓力，局部磨耗又反過來改變對位；應把承壓需求與材料、接觸及固定系統的驗證分開，不靠一個平均值判定可用。 假設徑向合力1.5MN、投影直徑0.30m、有效承壓長0.40m，pnom=R/(DL)=12.50MPa；非赫茲接觸峰壓。
上下轉軸相對偏移會改變轉動阻力及門葉接觸，角度很小仍可能在長門葉上放大位移。兩點幾何只能描述整體傾斜，不能辨識軸彎曲或埋件局部變形；量測需要共同穩定基準並補中間點，避免把溫度或儀器漂移誤認為永久錯位。 假設上下測點高差15m、水平偏移3mm，θ≈0.003/15=0.0002rad=0.01146°；只描述兩點整體傾斜。
大型鋼門的溫度變化會改變尺寸，陽照造成的梯度還可能使面板翹曲。均勻自由膨脹只提供基本量級，約束與不同材料埋件會產生額外內力；安裝測量若不記溫度，跨日對比可能把可逆伸縮當作製造或定位誤差。 假設鋼α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長15m、均勻升溫20K，自由伸長αLΔT=3.60mm；不含溫度梯度或約束應力。
啟閉機推力透過連桿和轉軸形成力矩，垂直力臂才是有效距離，幾何接近共線時需求可能迅速上升。假定阻力矩固定只用於辨識幾何敏感度，實際摩擦、水力及慣性隨位置變化；不能由單點力矩平衡自行推定完整操作或保護設定。 假設指定阻力矩200kN·m、連接半徑2m、力向與半徑30°，F=M/(r sinθ)=200kN；非實際啟閉設定。
油壓推力由兩腔壓力與有效面積共同決定，伸出與回縮面積不同，背壓及摩擦不能隨意忽略。單腔理想式可核對量級，但不包含閥路動態、洩漏和機械效率；壓力達到某數值也不能證明門葉正在按預期位置移動，需要獨立位移證據。 假設缸徑0.16m、無背壓與摩擦、缸底壓10MPa，F=pπD²/4=201.062kN；回縮需扣活塞桿面積。
閉合止水的功能需要在明定水頭下量測漏流，看到接觸不等於所有位置都密合。等效孔口模型只用來比較缺口尺度，狹縫黏性流與粗糙通道可能不同；隨水頭改變的漏水曲線、接觸印痕與對位資料應一起判讀，不能只用一次總漏量找原因。 假設等效孔口A=0.002m²、Cd=0.60、水頭2m，Q=CdA√(2gH)=0.007517m³/s=7.517L/s；非允許漏量。
procedureEn: Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths. A vertical plane strip per unit width provides an initial load scale. Leaf angle, horizontal girders and discontinuous contact alter real transfer, so the strip resultant cannot directly become the force required of the operating machinery during gate movement. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust.

Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening. Angle affects miter position, contacts and force transfer, but geometric agreement does not establish uniform bearing. Surveys must distinguish closure position from the swept motion envelope rather than using projected design dimensions alone to plan lifting or field adjustment of the gate assembly. Assume opening20m and each leaf20°from transverse. Leaf length=10.6418m and upstream projection=3.6397m, excluding joint and hinge details.

The skin plate transfers local pressure to stiffeners, with span and restraint governing bending rather than whole-gate weight. A simply supported unit-width strip omits two-way plate behavior and welded restraint, providing a comparison baseline only. Corrosion loss, initial distortion and connection details modify local response and must be checked against the actual panel arrangement rather than assumed away. Assume a unit-width simply supported strip,p=100kPa,span0.50m,thickness0.020m. M=3.125kN·m/m and elasticσ=46.875MPa, excluding two-way action.

Effective supported weight differs between submerged operation and dewatered maintenance. Buoyancy of sealed spaces must not be confused with material volume, while support sharing depends on gravity center, buoyancy center and upper restraint. A weight difference gives only the vertical resultant. Flooding or ventilation changes the buoyancy boundary, so an initial value cannot be retained unchanged through every installation state. Assume gate mass200000kg,sealed displacement50m³ and freshwater1000kg/m³. Net downward force=(m−ρV)g=1471.5kN, before distribution among supports.

The pintle transfers gate action into embedded support. Projected-area pressure is a nominal scale, not the actual contact maximum. Curvature, clearance, lubrication and eccentricity concentrate pressure, while wear feeds back into alignment. Demand must therefore be evaluated with material, contact and anchorage evidence rather than using a single average number to declare the complete bearing assembly suitable for service. Assume radial resultant1.5MN,projected diameter0.30m and bearing length0.40m. Nominal pressure R/(DL)=12.50MPa, not Hertzian peak contact pressure.

Relative offset between upper and lower pivots changes rotation and leaf contact, and a small angle can create appreciable movement along a large leaf. Two points describe overall tilt but not shaft curvature or local embedment deformation. Stable common control and intermediate observations are needed to distinguish true misalignment from temperature effects or instrument drift during installation verification. Assume pivot points15m vertically apart with horizontal offset3mm. Tilt≈0.0002rad=0.01146°, describing only the overall two-point alignment.

Temperature changes alter large steel-gate dimensions, while solar gradients can warp panels. Uniform free expansion supplies only a baseline; restraint and dissimilar embedded materials generate additional forces. Without temperature records, surveys on different days may mistake reversible thermal movement for fabrication or positioning error, leading to inappropriate adjustment of dimensions that are correct at the intended reference condition. Assume steelα=12×10⁻⁶/K,length15m and uniform warming20K. Free expansion is3.60mm, excluding gradients and restraint stresses.

Actuator force produces torque through the perpendicular lever arm, with demand rising as linkage geometry approaches alignment. A fixed resisting torque isolates geometry sensitivity only; actual friction, hydraulic action and inertia vary with position. One equilibrium point therefore cannot define the complete operating sequence, permissible thrust or protective settings for the machinery connected to the gate. Assume selected resisting torque200kN·m,radius2m and force-radius angle30°. F=M/(r sinθ)=200kN, not an operating setting.

Cylinder force depends on both chamber pressures and effective areas, which differ during extension and retraction. Backpressure and friction cannot generally be ignored. A single-chamber idealization checks scale but omits valve dynamics, leakage and efficiency. Reaching a pressure value does not prove that the gate has reached its intended position; independent displacement evidence is also required. Assume bore0.16m,cap pressure10MPa and no backpressure or friction. Ideal F=pπD²/4=201.062kN; retraction requires rod-area deduction.

Seal function requires leakage observations at a defined head; visible contact does not prove continuous sealing. An equivalent orifice only compares gap scales, while viscous slots and rough pathways behave differently. Leakage versus head, contact evidence and alignment must be interpreted together, because one total-flow measurement cannot uniquely locate a defect or determine its physical cause. Assume equivalent opening0.002m²,Cd=0.60 and head2m. Q=0.007517m³/s=7.517L/s, not an allowable leakage limit.
evidence: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。
在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。用獨立測站檢查閉合輪廓，另畫轉動間隙與埋件位置，將幾何誤差追溯到特定構件而非現場硬推。
核對板格淨跨與焊接支承，量測實際最薄厚度並標示水壓取值的深度。將條帶與適用板模型比較，另查焊縫和加勁材傳力，不以平均門葉厚度代替控制板格尺寸。
逐艙核對密閉、通氣與進水狀態，記錄重心和浮心位置，畫完整垂直受力圖。分開乾態與水中檢查，將實際支承反力或變形與模型比較，不把總淨重平均分到所有接點。
確認合力方向與實際接觸型式，核對有效長度、間隙和表面狀態，保留潤滑紀錄。用磨耗圖和對位量測檢查偏載，另評估埋件與錨定傳力，不將投影面壓當完整接觸分析。
evidenceEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition.

Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately. Independently survey the closed outline and swept clearances, tracing discrepancies to specific components rather than forcing the assembly into place based only on nominal dimensions.

Check clear panel span and welded restraint, measuring minimum thickness and locating the pressure depth. Compare the strip with an appropriate plate model and inspect weld and stiffener transfer, avoiding substitution of an average leaf thickness for the dimensions of the controlling panel.

Verify compartment sealing, ventilation and flooding, recording gravity and buoyancy centers on a complete free-body diagram. Check dry and submerged states separately and compare support response with the model instead of dividing total net weight equally among all attachment points.

Confirm resultant direction and actual contact type, checking effective length, clearance and surface condition with lubrication records. Compare wear patterns and alignment for eccentric loading and review embedded anchorage transfer separately from the simplified projected-pressure calculation.
pitfalls: 只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。支承接觸失效時荷載路徑改變，原本有效的簡化靜力模型也可能不再成立。
跨距增加會按平方放大條帶彎矩，局部厚度減少又快速增加應力。忽略焊接約束或初始波浪形可能改變應力位置，整體門葉位移小也不排除局部板格問題。
軸承邊緣接觸可能在平均面壓正常時產生高峰值，潤滑不足又加速磨耗。磨耗後轉軸移動會連帶改變門葉斜接，局部問題可能擴大成整門閉合異常。
單點氣溫不一定代表鋼板溫度，迎陽與背陰面差異又可能造成彎曲。若忽略這些條件，晨間可閉合而午後卡阻的問題可能被錯誤歸因為機械故障。
回油背壓存在時只用缸底壓會高估淨力，卡阻又可造成壓力高但門不動。若控制系統只看壓力完成訊號，便可能把機械未到位誤判成已閉合。
pitfallsEn: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. Lost support contact changes the load path and can invalidate a previously appropriate simplified static representation.

Longer spans increase strip moment quadratically, and localized thinning rapidly raises stress. Weld restraint or initial waviness can relocate stress concentrations; small overall leaf movement does not exclude a problem in an individual skin panel.

Edge contact produces high local pressure despite a normal average, and poor lubrication accelerates wear. Subsequent hinge movement changes miter alignment, allowing a local bearing issue to develop into abnormal closure of the full gate.

Air temperature at one point may not represent steel temperature, and sun-shade differences can cause curvature. Ignoring these conditions may misdiagnose a gate that closes in the morning but binds later as a machinery failure.

Ignoring return backpressure overstates net force, while binding produces high pressure without gate movement. A controller relying only on a pressure-completion signal may therefore misidentify an unseated gate as properly closed in the required position.

related.title: 大型船閘灌排水系統
related.titleEn: Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks
related.transfer: 可遷移「雙側靜水荷載」與「熱伸縮與安裝基準」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大型船閘灌排水系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Two-sided hydrostatic loading" and "Thermal movement and installation reference" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水壓傳力支承對位和機電幾何理解人字門安裝驗證；大型船閘灌排水系統則以從水量平衡到瞬變與船舶受力理解大型船閘灌排系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on understand miter-gate installation through pressure paths, bearing alignment and actuator geometry; Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks centres on understand large-lock filling through water balance, transients and vessel forces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雙側靜水荷載」與「閘室有效水量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大型船閘灌排水系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「射流動量與導流」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” and “Effective chamber water volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Jet momentum and redirection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 船閘人字門安裝
history.text: 人字門靠兩葉斜接與側部支承傳力，其安裝重點包含幾何、接觸與機械系統整合。巴拿馬主管機關記錄加通於一九一三年九月二十六日首次試通航，並說明原有船閘的人字門型式；擴建新閘使用滾動門，不能混用支承與施工假設。工兵團二〇二二年鋼構設計與二〇二五年機電手冊提供不同專業範圍，威爾遜二〇二五年修復紀錄則展示軸承板對位的實務背景。本課不提供吊裝或啟閉操作方案，各計算只是合成的力學與量測練習，需與真實設備及核准程序分開。
history.textEn: Miter gates transmit load through leaf contact and side support, making geometry, bearing and machinery integration central to installation. Panama records Gatun’s first trial lockage on26September1913 and identifies the original miter-gate form; new expansion locks use rolling gates, requiring different support and construction assumptions. USACE’s2022 steel-design and2025 equipment manuals cover distinct professional scopes, while Wilson’s2025 repair record illustrates bearing-plate alignment. This course supplies no lifting or operating plan. Its calculations are synthetic mechanics and measurement exercises, separated from actual equipment requirements and approved procedures.

references.scopeEn: Owner explains original miter gates and the1913 Gatun trial lockage; these are distinguished from expansion rolling gates.

references.title: 土木水工機電設計手冊
references.titleEn: Mechanical and Electrical Design for Civil Works Structures EM1110-2-2610
references.scope: 官方二〇二五年三月版本更新閘門機電設備背景；本課力矩壓力僅教學，不給現場啟閉設定。
references.scopeEn: The March2025 manual updates gate mechanical/electrical context; lesson torque and pressure are educational, not field operating settings.

references.title: 巴拿馬擴建滾動閘門
references.titleEn: Massive New Gates for Expanded Panama Canal Arrive
references.scope: 官方說明新閘為滾動門、原閘為人字門；只作型式辨識，不混用支承或安裝方法。
references.scopeEn: Official account distinguishes rolling gates in new locks from original miter gates; support and installation methods are not conflated.

references.title: 威爾遜船閘人字門修復
references.publisher: USACE Great Lakes and Ohio River Division
references.scope: 官方二〇二五年修復紀錄提及軸承板模板與螺孔對位，僅作安裝驗證背景，不引用預定重開日為已實現。
references.scopeEn: The2025 repair record describes bearing-plate templates and bolt alignment; used for installation verification, without treating a forecast reopening date as achieved.
